title: Proposal: stamp SALARY_ESTIMATED from BLS OEWS or JobPredictor when source-trial report has no pay
detail: Source-trial (JobSpy/HiringCafe) already supplies posted pay for many roles. When it is silent, open-source estimators can fill the gap without AI page fetches. JobPredictor (DeBERTa, ~750k LinkedIn) reports MAE ~$15.5k / 84.5% within $20k. nginyc MLP ~$19.8k MAE. BLS OEWS Industrial Production Managers median $121k is a defensible baseline for manufacturing/quality. Proposal: a small Writer Action that, for roles with no posted pay in the latest report, stamps SALARY_ESTIMATED (and source) from BLS OEWS title mapping or a cached JobPredictor call. Prefer posted pay when present. No AI tokens. Compare against current posted midpoints in the report shows most non-tech quality roles land within ~$30k of BLS; engineering leadership is higher.
blocks: Nothing blocked. Reduces AI research cost on rows with no posted pay.
options: Approve Writer Action: BLS OEWS title mapping only
Approve Writer Action: BLS + optional JobPredictor fallback
recommended: Start with BLS OEWS title mapping (zero model dependency). Add JobPredictor later if accuracy on manufacturing roles is acceptable.
action: Tim decides in chat; record ruling in asks/resolved/. Do not implement absent explicit approval.
